tasks.title: Create the prompt Loader, view structs, function map and embedded template tree skeleton
steps: Create the package directory internal/engine/prompt/ and add a prompt.go file with the //go:embed prompts/**/*.md directive on an embed.FS variable.

Define the Header struct with fields Name, Kind, View, Stable (bool) and MaxBytes (int). Write parseHeader(raw []byte) (Header, []byte, error) that splits YAML front-matter from the template body and validates the five required fields and the kind enum.

Define BriefView, PhaseView (embedding BriefView) and AttemptView (embedding PhaseView) with all fields listed in REQ-4.1, REQ-4.2 and REQ-4.3, including sub-structs ReportData, SpecData, BaselineEntry, CriterionData, TaskData, DiagnosisData, VerdictEntry, LandedTaskData, SurveyData, APIData, ReadRootData and PreviousAttemptData.
Implement the function map: fence, code, join, count, lines, ref, ids, title, trimSpace, firstNonEmpty. Each is a plain Go function registered via template.FuncMap.

Implement NewLoader() *Loader: walk the embedded FS, parse each .md file's header, strip the front-matter, parse the body with text/template using Option("missingkey", "error") and Funcs(funcMap). Panic on any missing or malformed header. Also implement NewLoaderFrom(fs embed.FS) for testing with custom FS.
Implement Render(name string, view any) (string, error) and RenderBytes(name string, view any) ([]byte, error) that execute the named template against the view.

Implement Hash(name string) string returning the SHA-256 hex digest of the raw embedded source. Panic on unknown name. Implement Names() []string returning sorted template names. Implement Header(name string) Header.

Create a minimal set of skeleton template files under internal/engine/prompts/ with valid YAML headers to make the Loader construct without panicking: at least one file per subdirectory (fix/, impl/, review/, brief/, partials/, tools/, refusals/, rejections/). Use placeholder content.
Write tests TS-21-1, TS-21-5, TS-21-6, TS-21-7, TS-21-8, TS-21-9, TS-21-10, TS-21-11, TS-21-12, TS-21-13 in internal/engine/prompt/loader_test.go and confirm all pass.

tasks.title: Add template-injection safety tests, view struct tests and function map helper tests

Write TS-21-18: set a view's Report.Body to '{{.Secret}}{{template "x"}}', render through the report partial, and assert the literal string appears in the output.
Write TS-21-19: render a test template using {{fence "REPORT" .Body}} with body containing special characters and template syntax; assert BEGIN/END markers and verbatim content.

Write TS-21-41 (property test): generate a set of strings containing {{, }}, {{template}}, {{.Field}}, {{range}}, {{if}}, set each as a field on a view, render through a test template, and assert verbatim output.
Write TS-21-42 (property test): for every template name, call Hash twice and assert deterministic 64-char hex digest.
Write TS-21-49: construct a test FS with a template whose kind is 'invalid_kind', call NewLoaderFrom, and assert it panics with a message naming the template and the invalid kind.
Write TS-21-50: render test templates exercising each function map helper (fence, code, join, count, lines, trimSpace, firstNonEmpty) and assert correct output.
Ensure all tests pass with go test ./internal/engine/prompt/... -count=1.

Read codefix/phases.go and codeimpl/phases.go rejection messages. Create rejections/missing_verdicts.md and rejections/weak_evidence.md with YAML headers (kind: rejection).
Remove any skeleton placeholder files from task 1 that are now replaced by real templates. Run NewLoader() and confirm no panics.
Write tests TS-21-2, TS-21-3, TS-21-4 asserting all required template names exist in Names(). Confirm all pass.

tasks.title: Implement golden-file tests with UPDATE_GOLDEN support, stability and max_bytes checks
steps: Create fixture view builders in internal/engine/prompt/testdata_test.go that return fully-populated BriefView, PhaseView and AttemptView instances for each template, keyed by the view type named in each header.

Write TestGoldenPrompts in internal/engine/prompt/golden_test.go: iterate Names(), load the fixture view, render, compare to internal/engine/testdata/prompts/<name>.golden.md. On mismatch, fail with a diff.
Add UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 support: when the env var is set, write the rendered output as the new golden file instead of failing.
Run with UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 to generate all golden files under internal/engine/testdata/prompts/.
Add the stable-rendering check (TS-21-30): for every template with stable: true, render twice with the same view and assert byte-identity.
Add the max_bytes check (TS-21-31): for every template, assert len(rendered) <= header.MaxBytes.
Add the partial-reference check (TS-21-32): scan every template source for {{template "..."}} references and assert each referenced name exists in Names().
Confirm all golden tests pass without UPDATE_GOLDEN.

tasks.title: Add the no-prose-in-Go enforcement test
steps: Write TestNoPromptLiteralsInGo in internal/engine/prompt/noprose_test.go.
Walk every non-test .go file under internal/engine, codefix, codeimpl and internal/conform using filepath.WalkDir.

For each file, parse string literals using go/ast. For each literal longer than 120 bytes, check if it contains any of the model-facing keywords: 'You are a', 'Method:', 'Call this once', 'submit_', 'is refused', 'not allowed'.
Exclude import paths (strings containing '/'), test fixtures (files under testdata/), and template files (files under prompts/).
Fail the test with the file path and a prefix of the offending literal if any match is found.
Confirm the test passes on the migrated codebase. If any remaining literals are found, migrate them to templates or add justified exceptions.

tasks.title: Implement run-time prompt auditing and WritePrompts
steps: Create internal/engine/prompt/audit.go with a WritePrompts function: WritePrompts(stateDir, tool, startedAt, sessionID, phase, task string, attempt int, system, user string, toolDescs []string) error.

Implement directory creation at <stateDir>/prompts/<tool>-<startedAt>-<sessionID>/ with mode 0755. Build filenames as <phase>[.task-<task>][.attempt-<attempt>].<role>.md where role is system, user or tools.
Write the system prompt, user message and joined tool descriptions to their respective files with mode 0644. For tools, join with newline separators.
On any error (directory creation or file write), return the error but do not panic. The caller will record a warning.

Confirm all tests pass.
